Name: Unusual Windows for AT
Author: ariasonata
Description:
There is a mixture of over 60 geodes, plants, and other items made into beautiful windows for your farmhouse. 
They use AT to work, so be sure to buy a bucket and paintbrush from Robin, and look into your basic windows!
I should suggest, if you see a window that looks like a partial image, it is simply meant to pair side by side with the opposite one.


Thanks to the creators of these designs for their allowance for me to use their art when creating these windows... 
cometkins: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5443
Idalda: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9081
Taiyokun: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9299
and Lumisteria: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9256

I will be adding more at a future time of my own work, but for now, this is the start of Unusual Windows.
